overview: This paper identifies entropic barriers arising from curvature increases along low-loss connecting paths (MEPs) between neural network minima, demonstrating that these barriers—amplified by SGD noise—confine optimization dynamics to flatter endpoint regions even when the loss is nearly flat, and shows that entropic barriers persist longer than energetic barriers during training.

modules.name: Model Architecture
modules.description: Implementation of Wide ResNet-16-4, ResNet-20, and ResNet-110 architectures with proper parameter initialization, supporting multiple random seed initializations for discovering distinct minima.

modules.name: Data Processing and Augmentation
modules.description: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 dataset loading with mild data augmentation (random horizontal flips, random crops with 4-pixel padding and resizing), normalization, and batch sampling strategies.

modules.name: Standard Training Pipeline
modules.description: Full training loop with SGD+momentum, weight decay, multi-step learning rate scheduling (5x reduction at 30%, 60%, 80%, 90% of epochs), epoch management, and convergence detection to obtain diverse minima from different random seeds.

modules.name: AutoNEB Minimum Energy Path Construction
modules.description: Implementation of the Automatic Nudged Elastic Band algorithm that initializes pivots along straight-line paths between minima, iteratively optimizes pivot positions with elastic spring coupling and loss minimization orthogonal to the path, and dynamically inserts pivots where loss exceeds a threshold, using multi-cycle refinement with decreasing learning rates.

modules.name: Hessian Trace Estimation via Fisher Trick
modules.description: Estimation of the Hessian trace by leveraging its equivalence with the Fisher Information Matrix at minima, computing the trace from the outer product of score vectors (gradients of log-probabilities), with stochastic mini-batch evaluation.

modules.name: Hessian Maximum Eigenvalue Estimation
modules.description: Power iteration method to estimate the dominant eigenvalue of the Hessian using only Hessian-vector products computed via automatic differentiation, with iterative convergence of the dominant eigenvector.

modules.name: Hessian Spectrum via Score Matrix SVD
modules.description: Computation of the leading Hessian spectrum components by constructing the score matrix (N × CE shape) on a random subset of training data, followed by singular value decomposition to extract the top eigenvalues, enabling efficient curvature profiling along paths.

modules.name: Curvature Profiling Along Paths
modules.description: Systematic evaluation of all curvature measures (trace, max eigenvalue, SVD spectrum) at each pivot point along MEPs or linear interpolation paths, producing curvature profiles that reveal the characteristic 'bump' pattern away from endpoints.

modules.name: k-Step Projected SGD
modules.description: Modified SGD algorithm that takes k unconstrained optimization steps before projecting the parameters back onto the nearest segment of a path (MEP or linear), enabling controlled observation of entropic forces while maintaining path-constrained dynamics.

modules.name: Relaxation Dynamics Measurement
modules.description: Framework for initializing models at various points along MEPs and tracking their relative Euclidean position over effective time (optimizer steps × learning rate), measuring drift rates and relaxation times toward endpoints under entropic forces.

modules.name: Entropic Force Scaling Analysis
modules.description: Systematic variation of effective temperature parameters (batch size and learning rate) to quantify how entropic force strength scales, measuring relaxation dynamics and characteristic relaxation times across different noise levels.

modules.name: Optimizer Comparison for Entropic Forces
modules.description: Comparative analysis of relaxation dynamics under projected SGD, projected Adam, and projected SGD with Nesterov momentum, plotting position trajectories against both raw optimizer updates and effective time to assess optimizer-dependent entropic force sensitivity.

modules.name: Linear Mode Connectivity with Splitting Epochs
modules.description: Implementation of the splitting epoch protocol: training multiple sibling networks with shared data ordering for k epochs, then diverging with independent data shuffling until convergence, evaluating loss and curvature along linear interpolation paths between converged siblings as a function of k.

modules.name: Instability Metric Computation and Barrier Comparison
modules.description: Computation of the instability metric (max/min ratio) for both loss and curvature along linear paths as a function of splitting epoch k, enabling direct comparison of energetic versus entropic barrier persistence throughout training.

modules.name: Cross-Architecture and Cross-Dataset Validation
modules.description: End-to-end experimental pipeline that repeats the full analysis (curvature profiling, relaxation dynamics, linear mode connectivity, instability comparison) across ResNet-20/110 and Wide ResNet-16-4 architectures on both CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 to validate the generality of entropic confinement phenomena.
